name: qkd_astk_er_tap

pin_regs.reason: native EP e-read ABI: the service is combinational on SO (read request field so[12:0]) and on SI (e_rdq mux); ERL 3 = the EP's own three read stages, compiled into the PV calendar. A pin register would move every e-read and response edge against that calendar (qkd_astk_native_er_service_w has none). Only tag / valid / fault are registered, as in the service.

purpose: KVJ-D 2026-10-17 (kv_static_join_plan item 7): ASTK e-read qkd_astk_native_er_service_w (N=4) folded into the ASTK strip as an inline leaf on its SO/SI bus (wires-only successor qkd_astk_strip_er_s): the leaf carries only the bits the service touches (8 x so[12:0] out, 8 x so[0] in, 8 x si[632:569] in, 4 read ports, 4 responses: 979 pins) instead of the ~17k pass-through pins of a standalone service tile; so[424:13] and si stay parent nets. Cycle-exact replica (ERL 3, same fault law), lockstep-proved against the service on the full bus. Pins: S = owners 0..3 (strip rows 0-1), N = owners 4..7 (rows 2-3), W = the PV read ports + response tags + ck, E = response data.

slot_change_request: KVJ-D 2026-10-17: new inline e-read leaf 64.8 x 43.2 inside the ASTK strip (qkd_astk_strip_er_s), one per strip (2 per pvw), at the strip's row-1/row-2 boundary so owners 0..3 reach the S face and 4..7 the N face; W/E face the pvw read / response side. Die lead / Q-KVSYS-DIE to assign the in-strip site (ASTK_W reservation).
